استرزقت (form X)
# اِسْتَرْزَقْتُ (istarzaqtu) /is.tar.zaq.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَرْزَقَ (istarzaqa)
# اِسْتَرْزَقْتَ (istarzaqta) /is.tar.zaq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَرْزَقَ (istarzaqa)
# اِسْتَرْزَقْتِ (istarzaqti) /is.tar.zaq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَرْزَقَ (istarzaqa)
# اِسْتَرْزَقَتْ (istarzaqat) /is.t
